##### Project general facts

Soho Residence is a premium villa resort complex by Land Scout Asia, planned as a compact gated community of detached villas offered in three- and four-bedroom layouts. Its architecture follows a cascade-terracing principle: the villas are stepped along the slope so that every plot settles into the natural landscape, which opens up the views and lets daylight reach deep into each home. Crisp white volumes, wide overhangs, timber screens and planted roof edges set a contemporary tropical tone, while private pools, gardens and terraces keep each villa fully self-contained.

Communal life centres on a clubhouse with a reception, a gym, a co-working space, a cafe and a kids play area, framed by landscaped gardens and shaded lounging zones, with security maintained around the clock. Ownership is supported by full-service, hotel-style property management covering maintenance, guest services, butler and concierge assistance and on-demand electric car logistics across the island. Engineering is built for island conditions: standby generators for uninterrupted power, a private artesian well for clean water, and a terraced drainage system with underground reservoirs that protects the grounds from heavy rainfall.

Interiors are delivered turnkey, with wear-resistant materials, bespoke joinery and fixtures chosen to hold up in a humid tropical climate. Villas come fully furnished and equipped, from soft furnishings, lighting and premium appliances to kitchenware, cutlery, linen and curated decorative pieces, so a home is ready either for living in or for letting without further outfitting.

##### Location description and benefits

Baan Plai Laem is a quiet residential pocket on the northeastern shore of Koh Samui, within Ko Samui District. The land here rises above the coastline, giving elevated, green surroundings away from the busier resort strips, while the beaches of Plai Laem and Bo Phut lie within a short drive. Coconut groves, low-rise villa enclaves and the temples of the northeast coast define the character of the area.

Everyday needs are served by the shops, cafes and markets of Bo Phut, whose Fisherman's Village is a seafront promenade known for its restaurants, bars and night markets. The island ring road links the area with Choeng Mon and Chaweng, and Samui International Airport sits close at hand for regional connections. Private hospitals, international schools, beach clubs, spas and marinas across the island cover the needs of residents and visitors alike.

The northeastern coast of Koh Samui ranks among the island's most sought-after addresses for premium villa rentals, drawing a steady flow of holiday and long-stay tenants through the tourist calendar. Property in Thailand is typically held on a leasehold basis with an option to extend, a structure familiar to international buyers of island real estate. Limited supply of high-specification villas in this part of the island supports both occupancy and resale positioning.
